'''Balliol''' was an individual who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] aboard a [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Balliol was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They served aboard a [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]]. At some point, the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] encountered an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and a chase ensued. The corvette lost its way during the pursuit and was nearly captured by a [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]], but both [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were captured by a technologically advanced and [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|alien]] [[Fathership|craft]]. Balliol and other individuals present aboard the Rebel corvette were rendered unconscious and brought aboard the alien craft by [[alien droid]]s. There, the aliens celebrated a festival by pitting them against members of the Star Destroyer's crew in a series of competitions. Balliol and the Rebels bested the Imperials, receiving plaudits from the aliens. Shortly before leaving for their own galaxy, the aliens rewarded the Rebels with the Star Destroyer and declared the losers to be [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of the Rebels.<ref name="Night" />
